notes:
Video Studio now draws larger local originals for photo shots and generated photo references. A still photograph requested in a script can go straight into the film. A phone-frame test generated a 1,152 × 2,048 lighthouse photograph and rendered a four-second clip with audio on an RTX 3060.

When recording a script for a saved clip, choose “Keep the clip’s soundtrack under my script.” Music Studio lowers the original soundtrack while the narrator speaks and brings it back for music breaks. Full-length compatible clips keep their original picture packets.
